sources.title: Qwen-SEA-LION-v4-32B-IT | SEA-LION Documentation
sources.snippet: SEA-LION stands for Southeast Asian Languages In One Network. We performed continued pre-training in English and SEA languages on Qwen3-32B, a decoder model using the Gemma 3 architecture, and post-training to create Qwen-SEA-LION-v4-32B-IT. For tokenization, the model employs the default tokenizer used in Qwen3-32B.
